description: Discovers a site's advertised MCP endpoint (mcp.json / .well-known) and inspects its *declared* OAuth/transport posture (advertised, not guaranteed-working — it does not run a full live handshake). Use when checking whether a site exposes a connectable MCP server and what it claims to support. Result: { handshake_ok, declared_endpoint, declared_tool_names[], score, tool_schema_version }.

brand.description: Optional brand/company name; inferred from the domain when absent.

url.description: Absolute https URL of the target (any public domain).

name: probe_mcp_functional

declared_endpoint.description: Endpoint URL declared in the manifest.

tools_listed.description: Count of tools the endpoint listed (≥0).

title: Probe MCP Endpoint Posture
